_comment: The pilgrim's notebook -- a KEY ITEM, and the reason thoughts exist: it is where he articulates what he never says aloud, so without one a thought never finishes becoming one (it waits, and the want surfaces instead -- see the `notebook` rule in psyche.json). Found in his room at the start, not started with.
name: Worn Notebook
description: A soft-cornered notebook, its pages half-filled. Where the things you come to understand get written down.
